common.name: Full name
common.offline: You’re offline. Changes will need a connection.

landing.h1a: Guidance from people who sat in
landing.sub: Verified alumni of {{college}} mentor you, refer you, and show you the exact path from where you are to where they got.
landing.foot: Private to {{college}}. Only verified students, alumni and faculty can see anything here.

auth.resent: If that email has an account, a new link is on its way.
auth.signUpSub: Takes a minute. College verification comes next.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few unusual words work well.

consent.account: Run my account: sign-in, security and showing my profile to verified members of my college. Required.
consent.mentorship_matching: Use my branch, interests and goals to suggest mentors and mentees.
consent.email_digests: Send me a weekly email with openings and guidance from my college.
consent.analytics_aggregate: Count my activity in anonymous, college-level statistics.

auth.privacyNote: You can change these any time in Settings → Privacy. We never sell or share your data.
auth.checkEmailBody: If the details are right, a confirmation link is on its way to {{email}}. It works for 24 hours.
auth.forgotSub: We’ll email you a link that works for 30 minutes.
auth.forgotSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.resetDone: Password saved. You’ve been signed out everywhere else.
auth.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open it again from your email.

mfa.setupWhy: Administrators must use 2FA. It keeps your college’s data safe even if a password leaks.
mfa.step1: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or 2FAS).
mfa.manual: Can’t scan? Enter this key manually:
mfa.codesBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe. We won’t show them again.

home.unverifiedTitle: Your account is read-only for now
home.unverifiedBody: Your college still needs to confirm you’re a student or alumnus. Roll-number verification arrives next; until then you can browse but not post or request mentoring.

phase.mentorship: Mentor requests, booking, chat and video

home.findMentor: Find a mentor from your college
home.findMentorBody: Alumni Match suggests people who fit your goals, and explains why.

settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings.consentsBody: Each choice is recorded with the date and the version of the notice you saw. Turning one off takes effect immediately.
settings.rights: Download or delete your data: self-service export and deletion arrive with the privacy release. Until then, contact your college’s grievance officer.

admin.brandingIntro: These colours and names appear on every screen and email for your college. Text colours are adjusted automatically to stay readable.
admin.featuresIntro: Turn features on or off for your whole college.
admin.allowedDomainsHint: Comma-separated, e.g. dpit.ac.in. Leave empty to allow any email.
admin.dropHere: Drop a .csv or .xlsx file here, or choose one (up to 5 MB)
admin.gsheetHint: Share the sheet as “Anyone with the link can view”, then paste the link.
admin.mapIntro: We guessed from your headers. Roll number and name are required.

kind.derive: Work it out from the graduation year

admin.dryRun: Dry run: check everything without saving
admin.rollbackConfirm: Undo the most recent import? New records nobody has claimed are removed, and updated ones go back to how they were.
admin.inviteBody: One email per line (up to 200). People you invite are verified when they sign up with that email.
admin.phoneInvites: Phone invites need an SMS provider, which isn’t set up for this deployment.
admin.noListMatch: Not on the college list yet

mentorship.intro: Activity in the last 30 days. Conversations stay private; you see counts and session feedback only.

platform.title: Colleges
platform.created: College created. The administrator has been emailed an invite.
platform.suspendConfirm: Suspend {{name}}? Everyone there is signed out until you resume it.
platform.privacyNote: You see aggregate counts only. Messages and profiles belong to each college.

errors.noCollegeTitle: No college lives at this address
errors.noCollegeBody: Check the link your college shared. Each college has its own address, like yourcollege.campuslink.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have access to this page.

verify.title: Verify you’re from {{college}}
verify.intro: Your college shared its list of students and alumni. Find yourself on it with your roll number and we’ll send a code to the email your college has on record.
verify.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{destination}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.doneBody: Welcome in. You now have full access to your college network.
verify.noMatch: We couldn’t match that roll number. Check it, or verify with your college ID instead.
verify.noContact: Your college has no email for this record. Verify with your college ID instead.
verify.idBody: Upload a clear photo of your college ID card. An administrator at your college reviews it. The photo is deleted 30 days after the decision.
verify.photo: ID photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB)
verify.pendingBody: Your college ID is with an administrator. We’ll email you when it’s decided.

people.title: People
people.search: Search by name, company or skill
people.emptyBody: Try fewer filters, or search for a skill like “SQL”.
people.contactPrivate: Contact details are private. You’ll be able to send a mentorship request when mentorship opens.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.headline: Headline
profile.headlineHint: One line, e.g. “Backend engineer · happy to do mock interviews”
profile.tagHint: Press Enter to add, Backspace to remove
profile.companyBody: Confirm your work email and we’ll show a “currently at” badge. We keep only the company’s domain, never the email.

palette.placeholder: Search people, or type a command…
palette.noResults: No results. Try a name, company or skill.
palette.label: Command palette

slots.noneBody: This mentor has no open slots in the next two weeks. Try a quick chat, or check back later.

mentors.title: Mentors
mentors.search: Search by name, company or topic
mentors.emptyBody: Try a different search. Mentors appear here once they switch on requests.
mentors.fullBody: This mentor’s requests are full for this week or paused. You can still look at their profile, or try another mentor.

match.intro: Suggestions from your college’s alumni, ranked for you. Swipe or use the buttons.
match.prefsBody: Only used to rank mentors for you. Nobody else sees this.
match.goalsHint: For example: Backend, GATE, Data. Press Enter after each.
match.companiesHint: Companies you’d like to work at.
match.noReasons: No strong overlap yet. Add your goals to get better matches.

reason.company: Works at {{value}}, one of your target companies
reason.available: Has free time in the next two weeks

match.deckLabel: {{name}}, {{left}} suggestions left. Left arrow to pass, right arrow to open.
match.emptyBody: Mentors appear as alumni switch on requests. Browse the full list meanwhile.

request.title: Ask {{name}} for help
request.noColdDms: No cold messages: a short, structured request helps mentors say yes. Chat opens once they accept.
request.pickFirst: Pick a time to send the request.
request.goalHint: One or two sentences. What do you want to achieve?
request.backgroundHint: Year, branch, what you have tried so far.
request.need: What you need from this session
request.needHint: Be specific: a mock round, resume feedback, a career decision…
request.sentBody: {{name}} will see it in their inbox. You’ll be notified when they reply.
request.sentBodySlot: {{name}} will see it in their inbox, with your preferred time {{time}}.
request.otherTimeBody: Pick a time that works for you and {{name}}. They’ll be notified.
request.declineBody: Pick a reply. A short personal note is optional.

decline.not_my_area: Thanks for reaching out, {{name}}! This isn’t my area, so another mentor will help you more.
decline.fully_booked: Thanks, {{name}}! I’m fully booked for now. Please try me again in a few weeks.
decline.try_later: Thanks, {{name}}! I can’t take this on right now. Do ask me again later.
decline.suggest_other: Thanks, {{name}}! Someone else on the mentor list may be a better fit for this.

sessions.joinBody: The room is private to the two of you. The link works only around the session time.
sessions.rescheduleBody_one: You can move a session {{count}} more time.
sessions.rescheduleBody_other: You can move a session {{count}} more times.
sessions.cancelBody: The other person will be notified.
sessions.lateWarning: This is less than {{hours}} hours away, so it will be recorded as a late cancellation.
sessions.cancelReason: Reason (optional, shared with the other person)
sessions.feedbackPrivate: Only your mentor and the college admins see this.
sessions.noShowBody: Only if {{name}} didn’t join at all. This is recorded and can’t be undone.

messages.intro: Chats open when a mentor accepts a request.
messages.emptyBody: Send a mentor a request. Once they accept, you can chat here.
messages.start: Say hello to {{name}}. Share your goal and anything they should read before the session.

mentor.pending_one: {{count}} request is waiting for your reply
mentor.pending_other: {{count}} requests are waiting for your reply
mentor.acceptingOn: Students and alumni can send you requests.
mentor.acceptingOff: Paused: nobody can send you new requests.
mentor.weeklyCapHint: When you reach this, new requests wait until next week.
mentor.availabilityBody: Set the hours you can mentor, in your own timezone. Mentees see them in theirs.
mentor.exceptionsBody: Dates when you’re not available, whatever your weekly hours say.
mentor.rangeInvalid: Each time range must end after it starts.
mentor.feedbackPrivate: Private to you and the college admins.

request_declined.title: Request update
request_declined.body: {{name}} can’t take your request right now.

request_expired.title: Request expired
request_expired.body: Your request to {{name}} expired without a reply. You can ask another mentor.

answer_accepted.title: Answer accepted
answer_accepted.body: Your answer was marked as the best answer.

question_approved.title: Question published
question_approved.body: Your question is now visible to your college.

question_rejected.title: Question not published
question_rejected.body: Moderators didn’t publish your question ({{reason}}). Open it to see why.

content_removed.title: Content removed
content_removed.body: Moderators removed your {{content}}. Open it to see why, and appeal if you disagree.

appeal_decided.title: Appeal decided
appeal_decided.body: Moderators reviewed your appeal about your {{content}}.

referral_received.title: Referral request
referral_received.body: {{name}} asked you for a referral at {{company}}.

referral_declined.title: Referral update
referral_declined.body: {{name}} can’t refer you at {{company}} right now.

referral_expired.title: Referral request expired
referral_expired.body: Your referral request to {{name}} expired without a reply.

roadmap_nudge.title: Your weekly roadmap goal
roadmap_nudge.body: A small step on “{{roadmap}}” this week keeps you on track.

event_updated.title: Event changed
event_updated.body: “{{event}}” has new details. Check the time and place.

event_promoted.title: You’re in
event_promoted.body: A place opened up: you’re now going to “{{event}}”.

notifications.pushBody: Get alerts on this device even when the app is closed.
notifications.pushOff: Not available here (this browser, or push isn’t set up for this college yet).
notifications.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
notifications.pushUnavailable: Push needs the installed app (service worker).
notifications.channels: What you hear about, and how

catHint.messages: Only while you’re offline; at most one email per chat every 30 minutes
catHint.community: Comments, replies and answers to your posts and questions
catHint.moderation: Removals, restorations, appeals and question reviews
catHint.jobs: Referral replies and daily job-alert matches
catHint.roadmaps: Weekly goal nudges and review decisions
catHint.events: Reminders, changes, cancellations and waitlist places

notifications.quietBody: Hold email and push during these hours
notifications.quietNote: Session reminders still arrive on time.

safety.blockBody: You won’t see each other in mentor lists, your chat closes, open requests are withdrawn and future sessions are cancelled. They aren’t told that you blocked them.
safety.reportBody: College moderators review reports. For messages they see only the reported message, never the whole chat.

content.question: question
content.reportBody: College moderators review reports. The author isn’t told who reported.
content.deleteBody: It’s removed for everyone, with its replies and media. This can’t be undone.
content.blockBody: You won’t see each other’s posts, comments, stories or answers. They aren’t told that you blocked them.

feed.composerPrompt: Share something useful with your college…

placeholder.text: A tip, an update, a question for alumni…
placeholder.poll: Ask a question for the poll

feed.formatHint: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, “- ” lists and #hashtags work. Links must start with https://.
feed.altHint: Helps people who use screen readers. Required.
feed.videoDescriptionHint: What someone would miss without seeing it. Length: {{seconds}} s.
feed.linkHint: We show the page title and summary only, never images or the full page.
feed.markAnnouncement: Mark as an official college announcement
feed.emptyForYouBody: When alumni and staff post, or your college adds news sources, it shows up here.
feed.emptyFollowingBody: Follow people, topics or sources to fill this tab. It shows the newest first.
feed.postGoneBody: It may have been deleted, or you no longer see each other.
feed.noComments: No comments yet. Start the conversation.
feed.savedIntro: Posts you saved. Only you can see this list.
feed.savedEmptyBody: Tap the bookmark on a post to keep it here.
feed.reelsIntro: Short tips (up to a minute) from alumni and staff. Videos play muted with captions in the description; they never play by themselves when you prefer reduced motion.
feed.reelsEmptyBody: Alumni and staff can post a Tips reel from the composer.
feed.followingIntro: Your Following tab shows posts from people and topics you follow, and news from sources you follow.
feed.sourcesIntro: Added by your college. We show a headline, a short snippet and a link to the publisher.
feed.noSources: Your college hasn’t added any sources yet.
feed.noPeople: You don’t follow anyone yet. Find alumni in

qa.title: Q&A
qa.intro: Ask alumni and staff. Questions are checked by a moderator before they appear.
qa.askBody: A moderator checks it first, usually within a day. You’ll get a notification.
qa.questionTitleHint: One clear question, at least 10 characters.
qa.detailsHint: Your branch, year and what you’ve tried help people answer well. Don’t share phone numbers.
qa.emptyBody: Be the first to ask, or try another topic.
qa.goneBody: It may be waiting for review, or it was removed.
qa.pendingNote: Only you can see this until a moderator approves it.
qa.answerHint: Share what worked for you. At least 10 characters.
qa.teaserBody: Moderated Q&A for placements, GATE, higher studies and more

mod.intro: Every removal tells the author why, and they can appeal once. A different moderator reviews appeals against your own decisions.
mod.removedBody: Only you and moderators can see it ({{when}}).
mod.appealBody: Explain why this should be restored. You can appeal once; another moderator decides.
mod.appeal_open: Your appeal is waiting for a moderator.
mod.appeal_upheld: Your appeal was reviewed and the removal stands.
mod.appeal_reversed: Your appeal was accepted and it’s restored.
mod.removed: Removed. The author is told why.
mod.removeBody: The author sees the reason and your note, and can appeal once.
mod.noteToAuthorHint: Be specific and kind. They will read this.
mod.rejectedToast: Not approved. The asker is told why.
mod.secondPair: If you removed this yourself, only “Restore” is available to you; another moderator can keep it removed.

sources.intro: News comes only from official RSS or Atom feeds. Each source is tested first; we respect robots.txt and show a headline, a snippet and a link out.
sources.addBody: Paste an RSS or Atom feed URL and test it before adding.
sources.urlHint: An RSS or Atom address, starting with https://
sources.name: Name
sources.intervalHint: We also honour the publisher’s caching and rate-limit headers.
sources.added: Source added. First fetch is queued.
sources.emptyBody: Add a feed, or pick from the verified starter list below.
sources.lastError_one: Last error: {{error}} ({{count}} failure in a row)
sources.lastError_other: Last error: {{error}} ({{count}} failures in a row)
sources.removeBody: Its items leave the feed and followers stop seeing it.
sources.starterIntro: Feeds from reputable publishers. A feed can be added only after our automated check confirms it works and allows fetching.

jobs.title: Job Radar
jobs.intro: Openings from your alumni and staff, plus verified public job boards. Apply on the employer’s site; ask alumni there for a referral.
jobs.emptyBody: Alumni and staff can post openings, and admins can add verified job boards.
jobs.noMatchesBody: Try fewer filters, or create an alert to hear when one appears.
jobs.alertCreated: Alert created. We check once a day.
jobs.trackerIntro: Your saved jobs and where each application stands. Only you can see this.
jobs.trackerEmptyBody: Save jobs from Job Radar to track your applications here.
jobs.alertsIntro: Up to five saved searches, checked once a day.
jobs.noAlerts: No alerts yet. Filter Job Radar and choose “Alert me”.
jobs.goneBody: It may have been removed, or you no longer see each other.
jobs.noDescription: The employer’s page has the full description.
jobs.importedFrom: Imported from {{source}}. Check details on the employer’s site.
jobs.noAlumni: No alumni from your college have this company on their profile yet.
jobs.noReferrers: None of them accept referral requests right now.
jobs.postIntro: Share a real opening at your company or one you know well. Students apply on the employer’s site.

fields.title: Role title
fields.applyUrlHint: The employer’s own page, starting with https://
fields.descriptionHint: What the role involves and who should apply. Plain text; **bold** and lists work.
fields.skillsHint: Press Enter after each skill (up to 12)
fields.branches: Suits these branches (leave empty for any)

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.introAlumni: Requests from students and alumni for openings at your company. You set the weekly limit; turning off stops new requests.
referrals.introStudent: Your referral requests. Each alumnus decides; requests expire after 14 days.
referrals.emptyReceivedBody: Turn on referrals in settings so students can ask you.
referrals.emptySentBody: Open a job in Job Radar and ask an alumnus who works there.
referrals.noCompany: Add your current company to your profile to receive requests.
referrals.noteHint: e.g. which teams you can refer for

templates.not_a_fit: Thanks for asking. Your profile isn’t a close fit for this role, so a referral wouldn’t help you here.
templates.no_openings: Thanks for asking. This team isn’t hiring through referrals right now.
templates.cap_reached: Thanks for asking. I’ve used my referrals for now; please try again later.
templates.other: Thanks for asking. I can’t refer you for this one.

referrals.referHint: e.g. “Submitted. Watch for an email from HR.”
referrals.askBody: Explain why you fit the role at {{company}}. They can see your profile.
referrals.whyHint: Your relevant projects, skills and year. At least 30 characters.
referrals.resumeHint: Optional. Only this alumnus can open it.

jobSources.intro: Bring openings in from public job boards and notices. Each source is tested first and checked on a schedule; we link to the employer’s own page.
jobSources.addBody: Pick a source type and test it before adding.

kindHint.greenhouse: The name after boards.greenhouse.io/ in the company’s careers link
kindHint.adzuna: Needs the deployment’s Adzuna keys; results say “Jobs by Adzuna”
kindHint.rss: Government notices or company career feeds; robots.txt is respected

jobSources.boardHint: Letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore
jobSources.name: Display name
jobSources.nameHint: Also used as the company name for boards
jobSources.added: Source added. Openings are being imported.
jobSources.removeBody: Its open jobs close. Saved jobs stay in members’ trackers.
jobSources.emptyBody: Add a board, or pick a verified one below.
jobSources.starterIntro: Public boards of employers that hire in India. A board can be added only after our automated check confirms it answers and lists openings in India.

roadmaps.title: Roadmaps
roadmaps.intro: Researched, cited paths from first steps to job-ready, reviewed by your college. Explore the Career Galaxy, follow one and mark steps as you go.
roadmaps.galaxyLabel: Career Galaxy: roadmaps grouped by category. Each star opens a roadmap.
roadmaps.graphLabel: Roadmap steps and how they connect
roadmaps.graphLegend: Arrows point to what comes next. Dashed outlines need review; gold outlines are projects. Scroll to pan.
roadmaps.disclaimer: Time estimates are about right for part-time study, not promises. Roadmaps link to free resources and official pages; check dates, fees and cut-offs there.
roadmaps.needsReviewNote: This step rests on editorial judgement rather than a confirmed source. Treat it as a suggestion.

draftBanner.draft: Draft version {{version}} is open. It isn’t visible to students until it’s reviewed.

roadmaps.goalHint: A gentle nudge once a week if you’re behind. Never by email unless you turn it on.
roadmaps.commentsHint: Only people who write or review roadmaps see these.
roadmaps.addComment: Suggest a change to this step
roadmaps.noChanges: No changes from the previous version.
roadmaps.awaitingOther: Waiting for a reviewer who didn’t edit this version.

editor.intro: Cite a source for every step, or mark it “needs review”. A different reviewer publishes it.
editor.title: Title
editor.summary: Summary (who it’s for, what the role does)
editor.roadmapSources: Sources for the whole roadmap (at least two)
editor.stepSummary: What to learn and why it matters
editor.rules: No exam dates, fees or cut-offs: link to the official page instead. Time estimates are your judgement.

review.title: Review roadmaps
review.intro: Approve changes made by others; you can’t approve versions you edited. Library updates can be approved by any reviewer.

library.title: Researched library
library.intro: Cited roadmaps researched for engineering students. Install them for your college; updates arrive as proposals for review.

first_step.name: First step
first_step.description: You marked your first roadmap step done.

roadmap_finisher.name: Roadmap finisher
roadmap_finisher.description: You finished every step of a roadmap.

streak_7.name: 7-day streak
streak_7.description: You learned something seven days in a row.

streak_30.name: 30-day streak
streak_30.description: Thirty days in a row. Steady wins.

first_session.name: First session
first_session.description: You completed your first mentorship session.

roadmap_author.name: Roadmap author
roadmap_author.description: A roadmap you wrote was published.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.intro: XP, streaks and badges for learning and taking part. Points come from real actions, never from activity with yourself.
progress.streakHint: Days in a row with a learning step, session, answer or event.
progress.nothingYet: No points yet. Mark a roadmap step done to start.
progress.optLeaderboard: Show me on the college leaderboard
progress.optWall: Show me on the Wall of Mentors
progress.privacyHint: Off by default. Only your name, photo, branch and points are shown.
progress.how: Roadmap steps, finished roadmaps, accepted answers, sessions, feedback and events you attend earn XP. Mentoring, referrals and hosting earn impact. Each action pays once, some have a daily limit, and admins can reverse points that were not earned fairly.
progress.leaderboardIntro: This month’s XP among members who chose to appear.
progress.boardEmpty: Nobody has opted in yet this month.
progress.wallIntro: Alumni who mentor, refer and host, by mentor level. Only those who opted in appear.
progress.wallEmpty: No mentors on the wall yet.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.intro: Your college’s rewards: certificates, event invites and goodies. Spending points doesn’t lower your level.
rewards.balance: You have {{xp}} XP and {{impact}} impact to spend.
rewards.requested: Requested. The college will let you know.

events.title: Events
events.intro: Alumni meetups, talks, placement drives, AMAs and office hours. RSVP, add them to your calendar and ask questions.
events.waitlistPosition: You’re number {{position}} on the waitlist. We’ll tell you if a place opens up.
events.linkLater: The online link appears here 15 minutes before the start.
events.cancelBody: Everyone going or waiting will be told.

form.title: Title
form.linkHint: Shown only to people going, from 15 minutes before the start.
form.capacityHint: Leave empty for no limit; a waitlist opens when full.
form.notify: Tell people going about this change

qa.title: Questions
qa.ask: Ask a question for the host

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: Aggregated counts only: no one’s individual activity is shown, and groups smaller than five appear as “<5”.
analytics.participationHint: {{active}} of {{total}} alumni mentored, referred, answered or hosted in 90 days
analytics.jobsByMonth: Openings posted by members, by month
analytics.exportHint: Each download is recorded in the audit log.
